ideas.title: Uncovering Daycare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of daycare fraud in Minnesota and identify potential shell companies that may be operating in the state
questions: What is the extent of daycare fraud in Minnesota?
How much taxpayer money has been lost to daycare fraud?
ideas.insight: I believe that daycare fraud is a significant problem in Minnesota, and that further investigation is needed to uncover the extent of the fraud and to identify potential shell companies that may be operating in the state.
